title: Brits Watch 44 Movies or Shows in Bed a Year
paragraphs: For many people in the UK, bed is not just a place to sleep. According to a new survey, British people watch around 44 movies or TV shows in bed every year.

The survey was done for Silentnight, a British company that makes beds and mattresses, to celebrate its 80th anniversary. The company worked with Professor Sasha Handley, a sleep historian at the University of Manchester. The survey asked 2,000 adults in the UK about what they do in bed.

The survey found that people do many different things in bed over the course of a year. Besides watching about 44 movies or shows, people press the snooze button on their alarm clocks 402 times and drink 103 cups of tea in bed. They also eat 18 breakfasts in bed and spill food or drinks nine times a year. Couples have 13 arguments in bed every year, on average.
Bed is also a place for talking. People have around three end-of-day chats each week from their bed, either in person or on the phone.
Other popular activities include reading books, which 23% of people enjoy in bed, and cuddling with a partner, at 20%. About 15% of people simply enjoy the peace and quiet.
For many people, the bedroom is a special place. About 57% said it is where they feel most relaxed. Almost a third of people, 31%, said they would happily spend a whole day in bed.

Families and pets also share the bed sometimes. About 26% of people said they often let their children into their bed. However, opinions about pets were mixed. Only 16% welcome pets into their bed, while 31% are strongly against it.
Because people spend so much time in bed, many think their mattress is very important. About 60% said the mattress is the most important part of their bed.
